citation: Y. Zhang et al., Refrigeration down to 0.16 K using a frustrated magnet Gd2B2MoO9, Nature Communications 17, 1554 (2026)
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as stated on the article page
local_raw_policy: publisher ZIP and workbook are used locally and excluded from version control; only derived scalar validation results and code are included

analysis_definition.indirect_curves: heat-capacity-derived Delta T_ad values at 0.5, 1, 2, and 5 T in workbook columns 19-28
analysis_definition.direct_points: directly measured Delta T_ad comparison points at the same four fields in workbook columns 32-39
analysis_definition.prediction: piecewise-linear interpolation of each public indirect curve at the corresponding public direct-point starting temperature
analysis_definition.error: indirect interpolation minus direct measurement in kelvin

scope: This is an external thermodynamic-processing validation, not a claim that Gd2B2MoO9 and NBCP share a Hamiltonian or package architecture.
The twelve comparison points were selected by the source authors and are not an independent random test sample.
No source curve or raw workbook is redistributed by this repository.
